steps.say: Compare the tens first. More tens means a bigger number.
If the tens are the same, compare the ones.
The open side of < or > faces the bigger number.
On a number line, bigger numbers are further right.

figure.alt: A number line from 0 to 100 in tens with 34 and 72 marked.

hints: < means less than. > means greater than.
check.explanation: 4 tens is less than 5 tens, so 41 < 52.

options.why: 41 is less than 52, so > is the wrong sign.

check.prompt: A number has 6 tens. It is greater than 65 and less than 67. What is the number?
hints: Only one whole number fits between them.
check.explanation: 66 is the only number between 65 and 67.
